subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in future tense form.

Mass protests, sometimes, change the decisions of the rulers in democratic countries.

options.text: The mass protests, sometimes, had been changed the decisions of the rulers in democratic countries.
The mass protests, sometimes, could change the decisions of the rulers in democratic countries.
The mass protests, sometimes, are changing the decisions of the rulers in democratic countries.
The mass protests, sometimes, has changed the decisions of the rulers in democratic countries.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The mass protests, sometimes, could change the decisions of the rulers in democratic countries**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **present tense form**. (दिया गया वाक्य वर्तमान काल का है।)
 
• The words '**could**,' '**would**,' and '**will be**' all suggest the future tense form.
